decisions.reason: Locates the disabled expression in AttachmentChips (plugin-dock-chips.js:34), identifies busy as declared only in sibling AttachButton (line 7) and unbound in AttachmentChips so evaluating it throws ReferenceError, and explains the empty-occurrences early return at line 23 versus a present occurrence in plain phase making the left guard false so the right operand with busy is evaluated.

Explains that the render exception is caught by the framework's per-entry slot error boundary which unmounts the whole dock entry (all chips), not just the remove button, while the separate attach-button slot and its boundary survive; and that the diagnostic appears only in the browser console with no user-facing banner, matching the user-thread.

Uses the shipped v0.2.10 expression (and the maintainer's hardening-pass note) to establish busy pre-dates the diff, proposes both a data-present plain-phase minimal mount and a rollback/re-add bisect, and grounds discussion of the diff's extra defects: imageItem reading status/record outside the map callback where they are defined and the re-touched busy line making the diff look guilty. Avoids claiming the hover feature is harmless as-is and does not overclaim exactly when historical users first hit the failure.

Primary fix removes the dangling busy reference while preserving the phase guard, with the alternative of properly owned/lifted state via props.input or explicit props. Hardening covers (record?.items ?? []) for missing arrays, event.target.closest?.() for DOM targets, and moving the hover/imageItem lookup inside the map callback where record/status are in scope.

Proposes a jsdom/happy-dom render test with at least one matching occurrence in plain phase, asserting the chip/remove control renders and that no error-boundary capture or fallback occurred. Explains why an empty-state-only test returns null before the throwing line and why node --check only parses and cannot resolve free identifiers or execute the component, and adds a data-present slot smoke per registered slot component to pre-ship checks.
